hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *".example") ;; */.dev.vars|*/.dev.vars.*|*/.env|*/.env.*) echo "BLOCKED: $f is a secret env file — never read or edit these (AGENTS.md: Secret files are never read). Use the .example template instead." >&2; exit 2;; esac

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in */pnpm-lock.yaml|*/package-lock.json|*/yarn.lock|*/bun.lockb|*/bun.lock) echo "BLOCKED: lockfiles change only via the package manager (pnpm install / pnpm add)" >&2; exit 2;; esac
f=$(jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx|*.mjs) pnpm exec eslint --fix "$f" 2>/dev/null || true;; esac
